result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major performance/loading problem where a stuck spinner obscures content on the page.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is overlaid in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image in the 'Popular right now' section, obscuring the ramen dish and indicating the card image/content has not finished loading or is stuck loading.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the card image loads completely and remove the spinner once loaded. If loading fails, show a proper placeholder or error fallback with a retry option instead of an indefinite loading overlay.
